questions.question:
Change the following sentence into positive degree.

Mercury is the smallest planet in the solar system.

options.text: Mercury is smaller than any other planet in the solar system.
No other planet is as small as Mercury in the Solar System.
Mercury is the smallest planet than any other one.
The most smallest planet in the solar system is mercury.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. No other planet is as small as Mercury in the Solar System. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the superlative degree.
 
• To change it to the positive degree, the structure used is **"No other + noun + is as + positive form of adjective + as + subject"**.
 
• In this case, the sentence structure becomes **"No other planet is as small as Mercury in the Solar System"**.

Correct sentence: *No other planet is as small as Mercury in the Solar System.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Degree:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + verb + comparative adjective + than + other + noun.
 
• **Example:** Mercury is smaller than any other planet in the Solar System.
 
• **Usage: **To compare two entities.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Degree:**
 
 
• **Structure: **Subject + verb + the + superlative adjective + noun.
 
• **Example: **Mercury is the smallest planet in the Solar System.
 
• **Usage: **To show the highest degree of comparison among three or more entities.
 
 
</ul

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Thousands of people were __killed by__ the train accident that took place last Wednesday.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. killed in.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"killed in"** is correctly used to indicate the cause or event in which the people were killed.
 
• **"Killed by"** would imply a direct agent causing death, such as a person or an object, rather than an event.
 
• In the context of events like accidents, the correct preposition to use is **"in"**.

Correct sentence: *Thousands of people were killed in the train accident that took place last Wednesday.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Using Prepositions in Context:**
 
 
• **"Killed by":** Used when a person or an object directly causes the death.
 
 
• Example: He was killed by a falling tree.
 
 
 
• **"Killed in":** Used when referring to an event or situation causing the death.
 
 
• Example: They were killed in a car accident.
 
 
 
 
</ul

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment containing errors.

This item is in the public domain/ and can be used, / copied and modefied / without any restrictions.

options.text: This item is in the public domain

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. copied and modefied .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"copied and modefied"** contain a spelling error.
 
• When listing actions, it is important to ensure that each action follows the same grammatical form.
 
• In this case, the correct form should be **"used, copied, and modified"** to maintain parallelism.

Correct sentence: *This item is in the public domain and can be used, copied, and modified without any restrictions*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Parallel Structure:**

 
 
• **Definition:** Parallel structure, or parallelism, means using the same pattern of words to show that two or more ideas have the same level of importance.
 
• **Example:** "She likes hiking, biking, and swimming" (parallel) vs. "She likes hiking, to bike, and swimming" (not parallel).
 
• **Usage:** Ensures clarity and improves the readability of your writing.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can fill the blank in the given sentence.

Out of all the flowers in the garden, the rose is the ____beautiful.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. most beautiful .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When comparing more than two items or people, we use the superlative form of the adjective.
 
• The superlative form of "beautiful" is "most beautiful".
 
• Superlatives are often preceded by "the" when used in sentences.

Correct sentence: *Out of all the flowers in the garden, the rose is the **most beautiful**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Form:**

 
 
• **Usage:** Used to compare two items or people.
 
• **Structure:** Adjective + "er" or "more" + adjective.
 
• **Example:** She is more beautiful than her sister.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Form:**
 
 
• **Usage: **Used to compare more than two items or people, indicating the highest degree of the quality.
 
• **Structure:** Adjective + "est" or "most" + adjective.
 
• **Example:** She is the most beautiful girl in the class.

questions.question:

• **Example:** He kept talking about trivial matters to avoid talking about what's important.
 
 
 
• **"To make extra effort"** means to put in more effort than usual to achieve something. (अधिक प्रयास करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She made extra effort to ensure the project was completed on time.
 
 
 
• **"To be extremely happy"** means to feel a great amount of happiness or joy. (अत्यधिक खुश होना)
 
 
• **Example:** He was extremely happy when he got the news of his promotion.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

questions.question: Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.

options.text: After a tiring day, I had a cup of coffee with Sudhir.
There is a man sitting beside cat.
She saw an excellent episode of the series.
She asked an easy question, and I took an hour to crack it.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. There is a man sitting beside cat. .

__
 
• The given sentence has a grammatical error concerning the use of prepositions.
 
• The word "beside" should be followed by an article "a" or "the" before the noun "cat".
 
• The correct sentence should be "There is a man sitting beside a/the cat".

Correct sentence: *There is a man sitting beside **a/the cat***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Use of Prepositions:**

 
 
• **Beside:** This preposition means "next to" or "at the side of". It often needs to be followed by an article when referring to a specific noun.
 
• **Example:** She sits beside the fireplace.
 
 
 
• **Other Common Prepositions:**
 
 
• **In:** Used to indicate location or position within something.
 
• **On:** Used to indicate surface or position on a surface.
 
• **At:** Used to indicate a specific point or place.
 
 
</ul

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He was not able to answer as the question was __ambiguous__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Clear.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ambiguous"** means something that is open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **The instructions she gave were so ambiguous that we didn't know what to do.
 
 
 
• **"Clear" **refers to something that is easy to understand, free from ambiguity, and obvious. (स्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher's explanation was so clear that all the students understood the concept immediately.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ambiguous' **is **'clear'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Clear.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deep **(गहरा): Extending far down from the top or surface.
